INTERN_BASE.profile_bio: An intern at MUSE Corp., this rookie is about as ordinary as they come. If you told them there were 200 other interns exactly like them, they’d probably believe you. But every legend has to start somewhere. Maybe, just maybe, this intern has the potential to become the next great star.

Preset_Misha.profile_bio: Misha is the worlds number one Muse. She is the face of perfection, adored for always being exactly what the moment calls for. Effortlessly talented and seemingly flawless, she feels like she was made for the spotlight. Perhaps thats why shes so good at it.

Preset_Solani.profile_bio: Solani is the world’s second-ranked Muse, beloved for a voice said to rival the angels and a beauty to match. Discovered by MUSE Corp. after a difficult childhood, Solani climbed the ranks through talent alone, becoming a favorite among everyday people… and, much to her dismay, a certain top-ranked Muse.

Preset_Caspian.profile_bio: Caspain is the world’s third-ranked Muse, a title he wears with quiet resentment. Raised in immense wealth and surrounded by the glamour of Parisian fashion, many mistake his polished exterior for entitlement. In truth, Caspain believes every victory is one he has fought for. Yet being forever ranked third is the one success he can never bring himself to accept.
